hash_12fc0d1d69d489ac: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^And one more thing. One of our East Berlin informants recently switched sides and fled for Moscow. We have reason to believe he's in the Lubyanka building today.
hash_224a91f8542f2bfa: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Good man. Now I know why Hudson thinks so highly of you.
hash_7ede6d75fc37de50: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^He knows too much about our Berlin network. I'm thinking an early retirement.
hash_2dc9542d642aa271: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I'm sorry, I thought this was the Singapore Embassy.
hash_3298674ab81fe55b: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Not yet. I know you have this under control.
hash_5aef5030ce883ed1: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We'll meet you at the basement entrance once you have the bunker key.
hash_1e70de33d70681ad: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We're getting the files in that bunker. Do whatever it takes.
hash_b0efe601b166a2b: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We're almost to the tunnels. Did you get access to the bunker?
hash_193c86eb65b2e04b: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We're not friends yet, Belikov. Did you get access to the bunker?
hash_5873b631ae712d55: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Comrade Belikov, you've been summoned to the conference room upstairs. Secretary Gorbachev is here from the Central Committee.
hash_7867a5682f9681e3: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Gorbachev: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Comrade Belikov, have a seat. General Secretary Brezhnev has taken an interest in the new... security development.
hash_23e3386e9089fdee: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Gorbachev: ^7^Fmaxima_med^And you, Belikov. Who do you think should retain bunker access during the investigation?
hash_19269872fca30b29: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Gorbachev: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Until the mole is found I want security increased around the bunker. Zakhaev, do you have any recommendations?
hash_2bcda5ab5cfa0232: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Gorbachev: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Be thorough, but we don't want any significant disruptions.
hash_630df0fa70375b8c: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Gorbachev: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Sound thinking, Comrade Belikov. I would prefer it if only General Charkov retains his bunker key.
hash_574b4b765d5a4c51: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Gorbachev: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Comrade Belikov, we are in grave danger from the capitalists. Our collective, our very way of life is at risk.
hash_69b410b7f36a84ff: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Gorbachev: ^7^Fmaxima_med^There's a mole within the KGB. The Committee wants someone from the First Chief Directorate to oversee Colonel Kravchenko's investigation. If you've not met him already, this is Imran Zakhaev.
hash_25b4801d2dc76963: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Zakhaev: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Comrade Belikov, my apologies! Even your bunker access has been revoked. We can't be too cautious, can we? Secretary Gorbachev, I believe it would be best if only General Charkov retains his bunker key for now.
hash_47280e290063994d: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Kravchenko: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I'm not a patient man, Belikov. Or a compassionate one.
hash_72c1f7da36b18eb0: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Kravchenko: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Yes, and once we are finished with this mole he will be as blind and buried as his namesake.
hash_47a50d383557648d: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Zakhaev: ^7^Fmaxima_med^It pains me to say it, but in a troubled time like this even generals need restrictions. Secretary Gorbachev, only General Charkov should retain his bunker key for now.
hash_31e761406e2a8aee: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Kravchenko: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Apparently not everyone shares your beautiful sentiments.
hash_12b27390201d42d2: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Zakhaev: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Comrade Belikov. As Head of Security, I understand you've practically exhausted yourself trying to unearth this mole. How has that gone?
hash_152d105ecf092967: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Zakhaev: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Thank you, Secretary Gorbachev. And thank you all for welcoming me with open arms. I can think of no greater tragedy than a home violated from the inside. The trust and love within a family is sacred.
hash_64ac53049004674f: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Zakhaev: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I understand. Perhaps the love you hold for your comrades is so strong that you can't possibly imagine such betrayal.
hash_62ce5132498302b6: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Zakhaev: ^7^Fmaxima_med^The traitor will be caught, and he will pay a high price for his betrayal.
hash_6d754f854259d797: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Zakhaev: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We should restrict bunker access. I also want to cultivate closer relationships with all of you. I want to know your hopes, your fears, your ambitions.
hash_32dbf8cc4f8be11a: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Zakhaev: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Worry yourself no longer, sir. I've already ordered the bunker keys collected from the men.
hash_5fe00ac72ce10cf6: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I'm being watched. I need a bunker key, but first I'll have to kill the cameras.
hash_3e755274022970cd: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I have to get a bunker key for Adler. He'll need it to access the vault. Unfortunately, Charkov now has the only one.
hash_632e492eb47358c4: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Ivanov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Kill him...? I'll try. But swear to this: my own life for my family.
hash_10a847b84c1739c3: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Ivanov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I don't need to play your games. Just do whatever it is you're going to do.
hash_94095c6c3d73ab9: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Ivanov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Help? You need my help? Save your breath.
hash_686a32424bc3ad17: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Ivanov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^What? What does my family have to do with any of this?
hash_6b2202e59b80273: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Ivanov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Whoever you are, you won't get shit out of me.
hash_2a8118f516cf3b40: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Ivanov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Yes, anything! Please, what do I need to do?
hash_54f069ffcc1c8323: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Charkov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Belikov! I've just heard the most amusing thing! Let's chat once I'm finished here.
hash_3559d2e001fb2ff: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Charkov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Belikov! I've just heard the most amusing thing! Let's chat once I'm finished here.
hash_71bc7e4ad5ae0b45: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Charkov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Citizen Ivanov - I trust you are enjoying your accommodations?
hash_35d1401b7eaa2b12: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Charkov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Hell is not in my future. Your daughter's future on the other hand....
hash_3eba95643376ca15: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Charkov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Hell is not in my future. Your daughter's future on the other hand....
hash_42ecbbcee1ffefd: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Be advised, we have a situation in the holding cell.
hash_160aa835b586b6b4: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I don't know, sir. He doesn't have much to say.
hash_3e6546f4d0b1aeb1: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^The KGB has his wife and daughter's abductions already planned. That's good. I can use this to my advantage.
hash_73755630e4c7baa6: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Just let me know when you're ready to meet with him.
hash_57fae3d1c0d5b981: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^The General will be questioning a prisoner today, but should be available most of the time.
hash_3dfbd0c21c12719: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^What can I do for you, Comrade Belikov?
hash_338ee9edf6456aaa: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Charkov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^At times I feel like I would gladly swap places with any of them. Terrible, I know.
hash_69f3edfc2d7c1f4d: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Charkov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Home? Moscow is my home now. If there was something before I'd hardly know it.
hash_727b12a53da52b58: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Charkov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I'd wager all I own that the motherland will last far longer than either one of us.
hash_6f2f16ae8fd597c8: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Charkov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^ You were the better pilot, let's admit it! But yes, I miss that part of it.
hash_7055a14c9783d83a: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Charkov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^ Now you're just flattering me, Alexei.
hash_6dce0f8a0a774bf1: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Charkov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^No, tell Nikita no one else trusts him either.
hash_4d8383fb9119741a: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Charkov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Of course it's an honor. Yes, I will thank the Secretary myself when I have the chance.
hash_3e9f3dbeaeff8b9e: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Charkov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Please, stop playing me for a fool, Dimitri. I know you're the mole and that it is this you're here for.
hash_242526bfe4e98427: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Charkov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Sad to think we only fly desks now.
hash_7540ae268ce9edda: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Charkov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Tell me, old friend, what are you really here for?
hash_652d0819c1218f81: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Charkov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Still is, my friend. She's aged far better than I have.
hash_2c62178a4460f9f1: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Charkov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^The same, mostly. Still begging me to retire early to the country. Ridiculous, isn't it?
hash_6f40e6b244e44fef: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Charkov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Two old warriors, still stumbling their way through the dark.
hash_5f3ea954aac1367f: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Charkov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^What's next? Are you going to kill me for it?
hash_5de07c2c877464e9: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Charkov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Why do you think no one wants to play Durak with him anymore?
hash_6f256445fead3f6e: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Charkov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Yes, I am a busy man. Thanks for noticing.
hash_525ae06029bd03eb: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^General. Just a reminder that you're scheduled to meet with a prisoner soon.
hash_1c82616f961fbc46: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Go ahead and take a seat. He won't be long.
hash_7d8ca6013ed6f274: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I will be at my desk if you need anything else.
hash_2c0cd1e4afd545b7: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Sir, it is almost time. We can reschedule if needed.
hash_55a83353bfc61fb8: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Richter: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Oh. Are you here about my assignment?
hash_501dffc57c2dbec0: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Adler will be pleased. Now to focus on the bunker Key.
hash_4aefebfc091a9950: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I cannot leave a body out in the open; it will blow my cover.
hash_23bddf37740d9d52: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I cannot do that, I'm being watched.
hash_717af7a68df31129: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I could schedule a meeting with Charkov and slip this into his tea.
hash_7f9842b521c485ca: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^If I'm seen, this would be treason.
hash_5fe3faf4df7153c8: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I better remove any witnesses before I do that.
hash_64929858bb43ffb5: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I have a chance to kill Charkov. Kravchenko's office will have the poison I need.
hash_4695ff46bccbdb12: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I will be exposed soon. In the server room I could point evidence towards Charkov.
hash_23c77e1a21ed0de0: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^In Data Entry I could program this blank keycard into a bunker key.
hash_48c2472fbbe73c2: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^It is not easy being a double agent.
hash_32f2995fe6b45507: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Ivanov won't cooperate. Nyet. I should find leverage in the Records room.
hash_277bfaec672123aa: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Maybe there's a clue to the combination somewhere in the office.
hash_4e84bd2d11b71ef6: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Now I need to hide the body.
hash_6132165cfc705f8: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Once they apprehend Charkov... I'll take his bunker key.
hash_4174de9af51f86a5: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^That takes care of everything. I need to let Adler and his team in now.
hash_2b0eeb340629e24a: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^The armory guard has a weakness for Cubans. Perhaps a bribe could get me inside.
hash_784ee505adeb3257: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^The guard won't let me in. I need to get what he asked for... or I can take him out.
hash_671d0ed986ca1a35: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^These will give me access to the armory. Inside I could get a blank keycard to reprogram into a bunker key.
hash_444b3878d97af9ae: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^They're tracing my unauthorized communications. I can make it appear they originated from Charkov.
hash_4a7c61fedd49b40: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^This area is restricted. If I'm spotted here I'll blow my cover.
hash_8fef9585e211736: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Comrade Belikov. We have a dissident inside, Piotr Ivanov. Charkov wishes to speak to him.
hash_2e516233121f24cc: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I understand he's been collaborating with our enemies. He'll be sent away for good soon.
hash_30403aedd96bc2a0: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Yes, Comrade, I've already secured the room, but please go ahead.
hash_4ec173ace409ad60: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^It's not here. Sensitive files must be locked away.
hash_2760898be6347e07: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Armory Guard: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Ah, a Cuban cigar would really distract me. I'm sure you could find a personal stash in one of the offices.
hash_12937528ee630c9b: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Armory Guard: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Go ahead, sir. But please be quick.
hash_1377a3a77b0bf892: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Armory Guard: ^7^Fmaxima_med^How can I help you, sir?
hash_b63255d0ba64a51: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Armory Guard: ^7^Fmaxima_med^How important is pursuing this lead to you?
hash_74165b01c658cee3: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Armory Guard: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I'm sorry, Comrade Belikov, but Zakhaev has increased security measures. You'll need authorization from the War Room like anyone else.
hash_654448c2b1f7f653: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Armory Guard: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I'm sorry, I can't. Zakhaev would have my head on a pike!
hash_4bfea84ed6d32cdd: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Armory Guard: ^7^Fmaxima_med^My apologies for the extra work, sir. You can go on in.
hash_4250fa8d893bf9d9: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Armory Guard: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Sir. What can I do for you?
hash_788d2ec456d13729: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Armory Guard: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Wonderful! I'll let you in. But this never happened!
hash_64df93537adf20cb: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Armory Guard: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Yes, sir. Just for a moment though.
hash_1d2967864e616859: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Charkov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Is this your way of setting up my fall, Kravchenko? I'm looking forward to hearing the response of the Central Committee.
hash_60ab93c74a75ea82: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Charkov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Excuse me? Do you know who you're speaking to?
hash_73b0386fef6a4caa: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Kravchenko: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Belikov. Have you dug up my mole yet?
hash_2d7dd82108bfed8c: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Kravchenko: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Charkov? That's absurd. Where is your evidence?
hash_30ad6c48bc7e8c1f: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Kravchenko: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Charkov will be passing through here soon. When he does, we will apprehend him.
hash_7d978b0d913fb60d: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Kravchenko: ^7^Fmaxima_med^General Charkov. Just how long have you been spitting on Mother Russia?
hash_73197dca442af5b0: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Kravchenko: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Huh. I have no idea how this got past me.
hash_3bfd43a0c0fb1d04: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Kravchenko: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I do now. Your medals will no longer protect you. Please empty your pockets on the counter.
hash_726b467ea3c1a6fb: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Kravchenko: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Now go in that room without saying another fucking word. Anything else you need to tell me, you can do it in there.
hash_722c4bb1fa002aa: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Kravchenko: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Now step over there and lift your arms to the side.
hash_201ed2096b3d7eed: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Kravchenko: ^7^Fmaxima_med^No matter. We've discovered additional unauthorized communications. Within hours we will know the exact computer they came from.
hash_4bd16976e9b389ed: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Kravchenko: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Then you will have work to do. Get to it.
hash_578f143abcc45db3: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Adler's team is in the old furnace room.
hash_3ba1796f8acf1f74: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Adler's team will need uniforms to get past security. Luring two soldiers into the tunnels should do the trick.
hash_79f1edafec92aacb: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Okay, now I need to head to the basement and let Adler's team in.
hash_7b8f6bd03aafeb60: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Belikov here. Send a security detail to meet me in the furnace room. Immediately.
hash_7a4af01126b5494d: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Here. Our weapons and keycard are in the bag.
hash_2997c4cccfe55074: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Keep it clean. The uniforms are no good to us bloody.
hash_621074c7fad3dc45: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Once we're in the bunker, we're on our own.
hash_2e8aa50afeed82: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I don't have much choice, do I?
hash_40145dbc70a9e6ea: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I have to leave, but you should have everything you need. Now if stopped, you're reporting to Commander Sobol.
hash_529598b6579f5411: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I will lead them through and distract them. You two do the rest.
hash_66e922aec6979c2e: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^There is no excuse for this incompetence. We have very strict protocols in place to prevent this, is this clear?
hash_6dbae9fbd8d6648d: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^This keycard gives you elevator access to the bunker.
hash_1b07a964d75a318f: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Sir, we patrolled here just an hour ago. It was closed then.
hash_4da6f22f6b53fd48: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Comrade. Do you mind letting us through?
hash_7ebcb07b1cea0d2f: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^No metal detectors for us. We're going around.
hash_57228563edb87792: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^What do you think you're doing? Everyone must go through the checkpoint.
hash_860a683f81a366f: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^There's no need for that. Let us pass.
hash_17aa43d85c51aa2a: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Belikov: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Comrade, you are needed by Zakhaev. I will handle this.
hash_5171409465bc7bac: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Comrade, place your bag on the counter for inspection.
hash_3ce1d32340c9d5: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Don't take it personally, Comrade. My orders are to inspect everything that comes through - no exceptions.
hash_155a6e1797f522ec: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^It's assholes like that we gotta watch out for.
hash_39d5bd371ce7fc4b: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Zakhaev: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Why I have an appointment with him now! I'll give him your regards.
hash_6ce3cdd23da725c0: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Zakhaev: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Who did you say you report to again?
hash_5f5de53afef85182: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^They won't be happy to see us down here. Wait for my word.
hash_2539efeeb985335b: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Put those weapons on the ground!
hash_5e5d65f3e2f6345a: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^This area's off limits! How did you get down here?
hash_4720dabb1657711e: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^And then she reached behind my--
hash_6918545241310dc9: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Get the gas ready. We need to go.
hash_65adb7a063971301: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^If our exfil gets messy, we go to plan B. Bell, plant a gas canister in the vent.
hash_47d4fa0bd68b7e9c: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^If things go south, we need to secure our exfil. Plant a gas canister in the vent.

hash_77c610b1d07904da: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I hear they have adjustable heating in the GDR now.
hash_4625ff9a27d237ba: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^It's far too hot in here, don't you think?
hash_71cb35cbe9db9f7e: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Female: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Can you guys please keep it down? I have a deadline this afternoon.
hash_39bd11a38a3ca3cc: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Female: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Don't say it! I ate there long ago. There were maggots in the caviar!
hash_1c73a1a288b01d84: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Female: ^7^Fmaxima_med^The stroganoff is an old family recipe. We had it so much growing up I can't really even eat it anymore.
hash_2752a13d889e4d12: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Female: ^7^Fmaxima_med^You went to Olomouc! They will be so happy to hear that!
hash_5ebce2df425251: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Have you ever been to that place on Studencheskaya? It-
hash_4e4742031af7d301: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Last night we finally went to your parents' restaurant. The beef stroganoff was extraordinary.
hash_63e556a283c6413d: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Oh, Irina. I was just beginning to work up an appetite again.
hash_1e9a0be44617c355: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^And this is as far as I can take you today.
hash_245040c601de78f6: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Even if Secretary Gorbachev wasn't here, I don't know if I'd be allowed to take you upstairs. Family or not.
hash_626c32fb2a2bc966: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I don't know. Your questions are too good for me today.
hash_59b7d14f3c974661: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Are you sure we can't go up there? Just a peek?
hash_19c8cd510c7c2d2f: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Crossing over? I take it you've never been there before.
hash_7f2be559e4a82279: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I will in Mexico City. After that... your guess is as good as mine.
hash_32c2ee0c37f755bf: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Technically I will be in Mexico for a week before crossing over.
hash_678975c645e9eebc: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^They haven't even told me yet. I'm to meet someone near Santa Fe and get the assignment from him. Or her. The contact information will arrive one day prior to entering the United States.
hash_22e87ba4fbc3a5c4: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Do you mind if I ask you what you'll be doing there?
hash_445697cc766efba6: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^ New York City. But that's it.
hash_20437d593d2aa8b4: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Well, I'm envious. I haven't traveled farther than Spain since '78. Enjoy yourself.
hash_6f75297874543887: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^How will you meet him? It's not like you're invited.
hash_116c2b31d2a270f5: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I guess it is kind of a big deal.
hash_4be3b1eae09df0e1: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^You never get anything done anyway.
hash_36ab2b6497e7c63: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^It's definitely hard to get anything done around here today.
hash_5280e2adb301e82b: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Come on, you don't want to meet the Secretary?
hash_295300855ff5638b: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I can't wait to meet Secretary Gorbachev.
hash_35558f6fa58325c6: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^No, but maybe we'll see him on his way out of the meeting.
hash_76e7de1d44e5bffb: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Are you kidding? I haven't taken a vacation in ten years.
hash_264d68ca0c738861: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Wait, are we talking permanent vacation here?
hash_19bc27ee931cd8c3: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Well, my wife certainly won't argue. She's been wanting to get a break from the kids for awhile now.
hash_40a05f2e8384d5a: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I'm just saying, take it while you can.
hash_30ee091cfff7aaef: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I think now is the time if you know what I mean.
hash_7ed6b79e9db774b2: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I think we're going to visit family in Smolensk.
hash_448198dbdc858e24: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Alright. Well, it was a pleasure working with you.
hash_3b574ae4c7aafde3: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Can I get you a last meal from the break room?
hash_23a58345bf724bdf: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I'm going to go turn in your name immediately, if you don't mind.
hash_1b3408dc8b90fb41: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Viktor, did you hear about a possible mole inside the agency?
hash_38b459e83db2e326: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Wonderful. After all these years you've finally followed through on your threats.
hash_689b2fc4a1499781: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Hear about it? It's me... obviously.
hash_e9dafc459cf1d82: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I'm a man of my word.
hash_245ac193855c9923: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I've already eaten the lunch your sister packed for you today.
hash_1c3144ce20ba02df: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^You mean the one where he runs away with the butler?
hash_6983a5cde947737c: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Not really my cup of tea.
hash_75426010e3753159: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Remind me not to get my movie reviews from you in the future.
hash_59ba6e573ece7ae7: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^That's not the movie I was talking about, anyway. I can't think of the name of it, but it's about some idiot detective that thinks he's a spy.
hash_70924ae3f0f79e30: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Fascinating. I didn't know we had any operations there.
hash_315e2772f27de44f: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Don't mention I said anything, okay?
hash_142b1bff6bebfe6: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I don't know what happened. No one wants to talk about it.
hash_3a7ae3a469123a60: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^But there was an incident of some kind?
hash_2036d02227417bb5: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We don't, as far as I know.
hash_5a2a40009ca52642: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I drove hours to get here.
hash_46750ac1dae3ce7b: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I know it isn't. But if you would just listen to me for a minute....
hash_61428a463d51a47b: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I was told I had to deliver this in person!
hash_3ed9ef3575dbf39e: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I was told to show up this morning. I was told it was urgent. I drove from Gorky- all night. Have you ever made that drive before?
hash_338774743e3ced5a: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^No. I want to speak to your superior officer.
hash_73d02aad1369525f: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Really? What will happen if I don't deliver the contents of this briefcase?
hash_7e3db41b9651971f: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Citizen. It is not up to us.
hash_24b80b5424089379: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Don't force us to drag you out.
hash_5658c4536a90f32a: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I'm sorry. You'll just have to come back tomorrow.
hash_2a995b02e3726260: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^No one new will be admitted to the building today. Orders from above.
hash_30a33fd2e3b89aff: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Just don't touch the glass, people.
hash_73730ec05edf7df3: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^They bring their kids here, or what?
hash_517e4af0cbd993a7: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Dudnik.... I was just talking to him an hour ago.
hash_2ffc838e43076bdd: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Hopefully he died without much pain.
hash_338b65bec84de2da: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Has Kravchenko heard about this yet?
hash_c51add15e65483d: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^This must be related to that search for the mole.
hash_43367e54b0486ff1: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We have no footage. This looks planned.
hash_107ab32f9c5c6c04: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^What is going on around here today?
hash_6a4633b77b454c54: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Do you two need any help?
hash_700d82bddadd6bd4: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Of course not. It was taken from me like everyone else.
hash_3faf508499b3b98b: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Fyodor. Do you have your bunker key?
hash_3ad77db3c3638054: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I don't know anything about that. Anything to be concerned about?
hash_71021dc1411677f9: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I'm sorry, I'll let you get on with it then.
hash_505d2b2cc9ee3eb9: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^This is ridiculous. I already showed you my paperwork. I should already be on the way to my appointment!
hash_46d3008d8fdaea13: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We can't have anyone leaving at the moment until the current security breach is contained.
hash_21b18903182703d9: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Yes, a lot to be concerned about! Were you not listening to the announcements? You're not going anywhere.
hash_fa4eb404de4877f: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I wish I knew what was going on.
hash_4c030cba7b835688: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^What is going on over here?
hash_59ef7620f76d7d25: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^It's going to take as long as we need it to.
hash_300c8e58c46342e2: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Just let us ask the questions right now.
hash_165e97eb0079c246: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Did you have a prior relationship with him?
hash_455a9cdfcab66d0c: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Female: ^7^Fmaxima_med^It's just that we've never had to do this before. Are we in any kind of danger?
hash_6dfafe06f577bf4b: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Female: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Sorry, he just hates being late. We both work in the mail room.
hash_9dd90279544fef0: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Are you going to tell us what's going on?
hash_5199ecda80592c0b: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Our meeting was scheduled for this morning. Surely, you're allowing those with clearance to enter?
hash_32c3da0eea6feee2: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^It's not like we haven't had these before. And I would assume the mail doesn't stop for a security breach does it?
hash_787ec21f1891005b: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We are experiencing a security breach. Everyone is subject to the same procedure.
hash_79ee841fe60e7abd: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^No one is going in or out right now. Let me see your papers so that we can confirm your business here today.
hash_6a87e45898a61196: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Thank you. And your papers, sir?
hash_3bca344f7456f8a6: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^And who was it your meeting was with?
hash_74bbed2e05c8b125: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Just follow our instructions and you will be fine. You will need to reschedule your appointment, I'm afraid.
hash_6d1a07ad4ec7a3c2: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^It's for your safety, too. Tell me again what your business is today?
hash_749ac935f1f13aa6: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Just as you see the importance of your job, please respect the importance of ours.
hash_190682c3406fa2d0: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^He simply asked for my help. I don't know anything about the camera system here.
hash_25cfd5128891219a: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Tell us more about this other person...?
hash_7eb7633fda9ac9e9: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^What do you think about him?
hash_7510a9e6e46af02a: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I think he may be lying.
hash_28512e02e0bde062: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Kravchenko: ^7^Fmaxima_med^According to Charkov, he's definitely the one.
hash_31daab6a85cb941c: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Kravchenko: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I don't know what to believe anymore.
hash_1d5bb8c5b8f5f28: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Kravchenko: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I'm still trying to make sense of it.
hash_695bd671152fa137: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Kravchenko: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I would get moving if I were you.
hash_28c703dce0fee034: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I can't just go on repeating myself forever.
hash_630a11ebea0379d8: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I just want to go home.
hash_54435ab7ce73bba: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I was waiting to meet Olga Sokolova.
hash_1f5806be3e777097: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^No. I mean, yes, it's the same story. She called me in to discuss a missed transaction.
hash_1332e3af0524659c: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^And she never came down to reception....
hash_10af1a5bc6f7f93d: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I think you can. Let's step through it. You walked into the building two hours ago. You were waiting for....
hash_40f432e8ef18c41e: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Once again. What is your business here today?
hash_6cf5d1e8a26209ea: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Zakhaev: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Belikov and Charkov have a friendly history together, do they not?
hash_6846144b4c346888: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Zakhaev: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Find Belikov. I want to speak to him myself.
hash_1ade83b199521b7c: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Zakhaev: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Perhaps you should get back to work.
hash_2d718839f995ecc6: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^How can I help you, sir?
hash_31953357043eff15: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Sir. What can I do for you?
hash_61516c7c33c82587: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Is this going to take very long?
hash_6d7c4e2d985dd07e: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^Soviet Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^You are really not going to say anything?

hash_704c51a49a155173:
You're piloting a helicopter gunship, flying cover for a truck convoy of medical supplies through enemy territory. The action: furious. The concentration: intense. 

You are engaged in one of the most demanding video battles ever conceived.

Before you can begin the route, touch down the Rocket Module with precision. Push forward to thrust, pull back to cut engines.

^L^;The Astrobus follows the movements of the Joystick.  To blast meteors and space mines, press [{^BBUTTON_SELECTCHOICE^;+gostand}]. 

To pick up a  commuter, fly over their head and quickly pull the Joystick towards you^7.
hash_13192fb1e0d551da:
A bug barrage is swarming out of the sewer, chomping away at every building in town. Potsy, the rooftop gardener, is defending his beloved building with his only weapon - potted petunias. 

Help him take potshots at the insect invaders... Quick! When too many bugs crawl into the windows, they'll start eating you out of house and home!

^L^;Move behind a pot and press [{^BBUTTON_SELECTCHOICE^;+gostand}] to push it over the ledge.

Play for the high score and the game ends when the creepy crawlers have gobbled up six layers of the building^7.
hash_6feb9c11cf34b9a4:

^;Press [{^BBUTTON_SELECTCHOICE^;+gostand}] to fire your laser cannon. Dodge left or right to avoid enemy fire while pursuing aliens. Accumulate Reserve Bunkers (bottom left of screen). hash_59815ec282d28579:

The race is set. Are you?

Pass the number of required cars by daybreak to move on to the next day!^L^7
hash_1cf121c4765e8ff5:
The most beautiful picture you've ever seen in a video game! Two fishermen drop their lines into a bay full of sunfish.  But watch out for that shark!

^L^;Keep pulling in those fish, because the first player to catch their 99 pound limit is the winner! Go deep for the big fish (heavy) or play it safe with the small fry (light) near the surface.

hash_16cbba1a7c5322c4:

Complete a race circuit in the shortest possible time!^L^7
hash_226f72ec4afe482c:

The object of this undertaking is to rescue all the miners possible before running out of lives.

^L^;To fly up: Push forward. To run or fly left or right: Move left or right. To fly down a shaft: Step off the ledge.

hash_69210bf485d8938f:

^L^;You will be controlling the player on your team who is holding the hockey stick. This will always be the player closest to the puck. Moving your joystick left moves your player left, and moving it right moves him right. Push forward or pull back to move up and down the ice.

To take a shot, ^L^;Press [{^BBUTTON_SELECTCHOICE^;+gostand}]. You can control the angle of your shot depending on where the puck is on your stick when you fire. ^7

hash_5d25f23c7dedbdeb:

hash_567b3962dba14f3:
